Booking questions

Before you send

How quickly will I get a reply?+
[PLACEHOLDER: state your usual response time, for example within one working day.] Include your dates and pick-up address in the first message and the reply can carry a full quote rather than another question.
What information do you need to quote me?+
Four things: the date, the excursion you want, where in Nairobi we are collecting you, and how many travellers are coming with their residency status. Residency matters because Kenya Wildlife Service and the Nairobi attractions publish different entry rates for citizens, residents and non-residents.
Can I change or cancel a booking?+
[PLACEHOLDER: state your amendment and cancellation policy, including any deposit terms and refund windows.]
Do you take last-minute bookings?+
Often yes for game drives and city excursions, because those depend on vehicle availability rather than third-party slots. The Sheldrick elephant orphanage requires advance booking, so a same-day request may have to leave that stop out.
